name: gemini_to_chat_sse_truncated
_comment: Post-commit truncation toward Gemini SSE: upstream Chat SSE ends after a partial text delta (already forwarded) with no finish_reason, no usage, and no [DONE]. The router holds HTTP 200 and emits one native sanitized error frame, with no Gemini terminal (no finishReason) and no [DONE].
config:
[server]
auth_mode = "none"
allow_dynamic_routes = false

[retry]
max_attempts = 1

[providers.chatup]
dialect = "openai-chat"
base_url = "{UPSTREAM}"
api_key = "upstream-secret"

[[models]]
name = "gem-chat"
provider = "chatup"
model = "gpt-4o-mini"
